answer.answer: A single power-law slope can in principle be extrapolated across the 11-500 and 500-5000 um windows, but pump vs net sampling differ in mesh/filter cutoff, flow area, and size-dependent capture efficiency, so the fitted exponent from one method rarely transfers reliably to the other's range. Any converted count should be treated as a rough order-of-magnitude estimate, not a validated figure.
